learning_outcomes.text: Can explain basic concepts related to optimization.
Can model, solve, and apply optimal decision-making in problems in various fields.
Can generate algorithms in unconstrained optimization.
Can generate algorithms in constrained optimization.
Can perform analytical or numerical analyses.

syllabus_topics: Optimization under equality and inequality constraints
Optimization under equality and inequality constraints
Optimization under equality and inequality constraints
Optimization under special constraints and application
assessment_rules: The overall semester performance (midterm exam and quiz) contributes 60% to the final grade, and the final exam contributes 40%. The midterm exam and quiz each contribute 50% to the semester's work.
